headline: Aye Finance posts Q4 FY2026 profit of ₹86 crores, up 110% YoY, on enlarged post-IPO networth
sum: Aye Finance reported Q4 FY2026 net profit of ₹86 crores (110% YoY growth) with a 16% quarterly ROE on enlarged post-IPO capital base. The disclosure followed the fintech NBFC's recent listing on NSE and BSE.
implication: Post-IPO NBFC profitability announcements benchmark market expectations for RBI-regulated financial services platforms; this ROE and growth trajectory will set precedent for peer valuations and investor appetite for regulated lending fintechs in the institutional capital market.
detail: Aye Finance, a non-bank lender focused on MSMEs and underserved segments, announced strong Q4 FY2026 earnings with net profit of ₹86 crores, representing 110% year-on-year growth. The company reported a quarterly return on equity (ROE) of 16% calculated on the enlarged networth post-IPO capital infusion. The announcement was disclosed via an official press release filed with NSE on 27 April 2026, signalling robust operational scaling and RBI compliance in the regulated NBFC space.
